items.name: OAI.SevenEighths.HeckeFamily.LFunction_ne_zero_of_seven_eighths_lt_re
items.milestone_title: Theorem 1.1 (Hecke case) — finite-order Hecke L-functions over Q(√−3) are zero-free in Re s > 7/8
items.milestone_description: Every finite-order Hecke L-function over F = Q(√−3) has no zero in Re s > 7/8. A pole at s = 1 for a principal character is allowed. (The Quasi-Riemann Hypothesis, Theorem 1.1, Hecke part.) In the platform statement the character is a `Character` of the bundle `HeckeSevenEighths`: a modulus ideal 𝔪 ≠ ⊥ of the ring of integers of Q(ζ₃), a multiplicative character of (𝒪/𝔪)ˣ trivial on units, and a period N ∈ 𝔪; `LFunction χ s` is (1/6)·πˢ·Γ(s)⁻¹·Λ(s) for the completed theta-kernel pair of the bundle. The excluded case is exactly `χ.residue = 1 ∧ s = 1`.

items.name: OAI.DirichletCharacter.LFunction_ne_zero_of_seven_eighths_lt_re
items.milestone_title: Theorem 1.1 (Dirichlet case) — every Dirichlet L-function is zero-free in Re s > 7/8
items.milestone_description: The same holds for every Dirichlet L-function, including ζ(s): for every modulus q ≥ 1, every Dirichlet character χ modulo q and every s with Re s > 7/8, L(s, χ) ≠ 0 unless χ is principal and s = 1. (The Quasi-Riemann Hypothesis, Theorem 1.1, Dirichlet part; Section 11.2 and Section 20.6, transfer from the Hecke case by composing χ with the ideal norm and factoring L_F(s, χ∘N) = L(s, χ) L(s, χχ₋₃) up to finitely many nonzero Euler factors.) Platform statement: `DirichletCharacter.LFunction χ s ≠ 0` for `χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ q`, `[NeZero q]`, `(7/8 : ℝ) < s.re`, `¬ (χ = 1 ∧ s = 1)`.

items.name: OAI.SiegelZeros.WeightedTorusJets.exists_absolute_real_zero_gap
items.milestone_title: Theorem 1 (Landau–Siegel) — uniform logarithmic exclusion of real zeros
items.milestone_description: There is an absolute constant c > 0 such that every real zero β ∈ (0, 1) of every primitive nonprincipal real Dirichlet L-function of conductor q ≥ 3 satisfies (1 − β) log q ≥ c. (Uniform exclusion of Landau–Siegel zeros, Theorem 1, equation (1.1).) Platform statement: `∃ c : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ ∀ (q : ℕ) [NeZero q], 3 ≤ q → ∀ χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ q, χ.IsPrimitive → χ ≠ 1 → (∀ a : ZMod q, (χ a).im = 0) → ∀ β : ℝ, 0 < β → β < 1 → χ.LFunction (β : ℂ) = 0 → c ≤ (1 - β) * Real.log q`, with the three hypotheses on β curried.

items.name: OAI.SiegelZeros.WeightedTorusJets.dirichletRealZeroBound_proof
items.milestone_title: Theorem 1 (Landau–Siegel), conjunctive form — the same bound with the zero hypothesis as one conjunction
items.milestone_description: Identical content to the previous milestone (Uniform exclusion of Landau–Siegel zeros, Theorem 1): there is an absolute constant c > 0 such that for every q ≥ 3 and every primitive nonprincipal real Dirichlet character χ modulo q, every real β with 0 < β < 1 and L(β, χ) = 0 satisfies c ≤ (1 − β) log q. The platform statement packages `0 < β ∧ β < 1 ∧ DirichletCharacter.LFunction χ (β : ℂ) = 0` as a single hypothesis; it follows from the curried form by rearranging hypotheses, and the comparator file lists both names as targets.
